name: 26505 · Morgantown, WV
findings: ZIP 26505 (Morgantown) has 196 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 26505 (Morgantown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 22 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 11 in similar places of this size.
